scheme_name: INSPIRE Scholarship for Higher Education (DST INSPIRE-SHE)
authority: Department of Science & Technology, Ministry of Science and Technology, Government of India
benefit: ₹80,000 per annum (₹60,000 cash scholarship + ₹20,000 mentorship grant) for 5 years of BSc/BS/Int. MSc in Natural and Basic Sciences

criteria.label: Enrollment in regular Basic/Natural Sciences course (BSc, BS, Integrated MSc)
criteria.plain_description: Candidate must be enrolled in Natural/Basic Science courses (Physics, Chemistry, Maths, Biology, Geology, Statistics) at recognized university/college.
criteria.source_clause: INSPIRE Guidelines 2024 Clause 2.1 - Eligible Courses in Basic Sciences
criteria.remediation: Upload college endorsement certificate confirming enrollment in regular natural/basic sciences.

criteria.label: Class 12 academic performance within top 1% cut-off (marks >= 80%)
criteria.plain_description: Must have aggregate marks in top 1% of respective Class 12 board examination (or aggregate >= 80%).
criteria.source_clause: INSPIRE Guidelines Clause 2.2 - Academic Eligibility Cut-off
criteria.remediation: Upload Class 12 marksheet proving aggregate marks >= 80%.

criteria.label: Aadhaar seeded bank account for direct DBT disbursal
criteria.plain_description: Student must have an active Aadhaar seeded savings bank account in SBI or nationalized bank.
criteria.source_clause: INSPIRE Guidelines Clause 4 - DBT Account Linking
criteria.remediation: Upload Aadhaar card linked with active student bank account.

criteria.label: Non-duplication of concurrent scholarships
criteria.plain_description: Student must not be receiving another government scholarship concurrently.
criteria.remediation: Confirm undertaking that student is not claiming concurrent government funding.

application.office_name: DST INSPIRE Cell, Technology Bhavan, New Delhi
documents_to_carry: College Endorsement Certificate signed by Head of Institution
Aadhaar Card and Student Bank Passbook (SBI preferred)
process_steps: Register on DST INSPIRE portal (online-inspire.gov.in) with valid email and mobile
Fill online application under Scholarship for Higher Education (SHE)
Upload Class 12 board marksheet and college endorsement form
Submit application and download submitted acknowledgement
DST reviews top 1% cut-offs and disburses ₹80,000/yr directly via PFMS DBT
